body:
One night, whiled bored out of my mind I decided to smoke a little out of this fat sack I had bought that afternoon. One bowled soon turned to four and I was blitzed.  As I look throught the fridge for something to snack on I spotted a Nitrous charged whip cream can.  I thought 'this should be interesting'. Id done nitrous before but not in combintaion with other drugs.  About halfway throught the can everything around me dissapeared. Euphoria rushed my body as I hung in space, surronded by pulsating red and purple lights. I was standing at the time of the hit, and know my body began to rock in a trance like state.  I could not 'command' my body.  I was aware of it, but not apart of it.  I manage to speak. 'This feels so...this feels.'  and rocked for a minute or so more in my own mind-world.  I soon snapped out of my trance and stood stunned.  This was the highest I had ever been- and it came off of Bud and n2o.
